usage_discipline: Never repeat an identical invocation (same call, params, database, commit): it returns the byte-identical envelope. A truncated result will not expand on retry - issue a more targeted query instead.

Before finishing, verify that every distinct source domain the task requires has contributed cited evidence (e.g. tasks spanning code and knowledge must show evidence from each domain); an answer missing a required domain is incomplete.

An empty envelope is definitive for the anchor form you used: anchors resolve by exact node id, qualified_name, or node name only. Check resolution with symbol.lookup or bundle.explain on the anchor alone; if it does not resolve, vary the identifier form or discover stored names with a broader query instead of retrying semantically equivalent forms.
